{{Short description|German materials physicist}}
'''Manfred Klüppel''' is a retired [[German Institute for Rubber Technology]] department head of Material Concepts and Modeling group known for his development of theories of [[contact mechanics]] on [[Fractal landscape|fractal surfaces]]<ref name=rct2000>{{cite journal |last1=Kluppel |first1=M. |last2=Heinrich |first2=G. |title=Rubber friction on self-affine road tracks. |journal=Rubber Chemistry and Technology |date=2000 |volume=73 |issue=4 |pages=578–606 |doi=10.5254/1.3547607}}</ref> and of reinforcement by [[Filler (materials)|fillers]] of elastomers.<ref name=co2002>{{cite journal |last1=Heinrich |first1=G. |last2=Klüppel |first2=M. |last3=Vilgis |first3=T. A. |title=Reinforcement of elastomers |journal=Current Opinion in Solid State and Materials Science |date=2002 |volume=6 |issue=3 |pages=195–203 |doi=10.1016/S1359-0286(02)00030-X}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==

Klüppel completed undergraduate studies in physics at [[Philipps University of Marburg]] in 1982, and a doctorate in theoretical physics in 1987. <ref name=dikcv>{{cite web |title=Prof. Dr. habil. Manfred Klppel |url=https://www.dikautschuk.de/abteilungen/materialkonzepte/klueppel-manfred/ |website=dikautschuk.de |publisher=DIK |access-date=11 August 2022}}</ref>  

== Career ==

Klüppel started as a research associate with the [[German Institute for Rubber Technology]] in 1989 working on rubber's rheological behavior.<ref name="dikcv" />  In 2002, he became the head of the material concepts and modeling department. He was simultaneously a lecturer at the [[Leibniz University Hannover]], where he taught elastomer physics and rubber technology. He was promoted to full Professor of Polymer Materials in 2013. 

His long collaboration with [[Gert Heinrich]] produced a multi-scale contact mechanics theory for [[Fractal landscape|fractal surfaces]],<ref name="rct2000" /> which was recognized by the tire industry for its predictions of tire traction in both dry and wet conditions.  Also a [[fractal]] theory of rubber reinforcement by [[Filler (materials)|fillers]].<ref name="co2002" />  

==Awards and recognitions==

* 2013 - Honorary Professor at [[Leibniz University Hannover]]
* 2017 - Colwyn medal<ref>{{cite web |title=Colwyn Medal - Prof Manfred Klüppel |url=https://www.iom3.org/events-awards/awards/awards-archive/award-winners-2017.html |website=iom3.org |publisher=IOM3 |access-date=13 February 2024}}</ref>
* 2019 - [[Melvin Mooney Distinguished Technology Award]] from the [[American Chemical Society#Organization|ACS Rubber Division]]<ref>{{cite news |last1=Meyer |first1=Bruce |title=Photos: Rubber Division gives out top awards |url=https://www.rubbernews.com/news/photos-rubber-division-gives-out-top-awards |access-date=29 December 2024 |work=Rubber News |publisher=Crain |date=May 1, 2019}}</ref>
*2022 - Carl-Dietrich-Harries Medal of the German Rubber Society<ref>{{cite web |title=Carl-Dietrich-Harries-Medaille |url=https://dkg-rubber.de/hall-of-fame/preistraegerinnen-carl-dietrich-harries-medaille/ |website=dkg-rubber.de |publisher=DKG |access-date=11 July 2024}}</ref>
